user.title: Add a sleep routine
user.description: Choose the kind of routine you want to create. You can add more routines later.

nap.title: Set up NapMode
nap.description: Choose what NapMode controls and set its initial duration.

data.name: Name
data.lights: Lights or areas to turn off
data.covers: Covers or areas to close and open
data.end_lights: Lights or areas to turn on when nap ends
data.end_script: Script to run when nap ends

data_description.name: Use a name that identifies the room or person.
data_description.lights: Choose the lights that should be off during the nap.
data_description.covers: Choose the covers controlled at the start and end of the nap.
data_description.end_lights: Choose the lights that should turn on when the nap ends.
data_description.end_script: Optional. Use a script for music, announcements, or other end-of-nap actions.
data_description.duration: You can change this later from the device page or a dashboard.

wakeup.title: Set up a WakeupLight
wakeup.description: Choose which lights brighten and how WakeupLight should run.

data.name: Name
data.alarm_script: Script to run at alarm time

data_description.name: Use a name that identifies the room or person.
data_description.lights: These gradually brighten before the alarm time.
data_description.covers: These open when the alarm time is reached.
data_description.alarm_time: The time the lights reach their final brightness.
data_description.fade_duration: How many minutes before the alarm the lights begin to brighten.
data_description.brightness: The brightness reached at the alarm time.
data_description.alarm_script: Optional. Use a script for music, covers, announcements, or other actions.

nap.title: Edit nap targets
nap.description: Choose what this nap controls at the start and end.

data.lights: Lights or areas to turn off
data.covers: Covers or areas to close and open
data.end_lights: Lights or areas to turn on
data.end_script: Script to run when nap ends

data_description.lights: These turn off when the nap starts.
data_description.covers: These close when the nap starts and can reopen when it ends.
data_description.end_lights: These turn on when the nap ends.
data_description.end_script: Optional. Clear this field to stop running a script.
data_description.highlight_color: Used for this routine's active dashboard card.
